ferry

A job runner that does one thing: it moves work from a queue to a process and tells you what happened. No daemon, no broker, one binary.

Install

go install github.com/ridge/ferry/cmd/ferry@latest

Use

Point it at a queue and a command. Every run is recorded in .ferry/runs.jsonl.

ferry run --queue ./jobs --parallel 4 -- ./worker.sh
ferry why 01J8Z --format json

Why not cron

  • cron has no record of what a run did
  • cron cannot bound how many run at once
  • cron cannot answer why a run was skipped

The design notes are in docs/design.md.
